correctness.rationale: For a_i in Cr_n, odd neighborhood-color set equals P_B symmetric-difference {color(b_i)}, and dually. Even n forces |P_A|,|P_B| even, so every proper coloring is odd and the connected graph has two named optimal 2-colorings. Odd n needs ≥3 odd-count color classes on each side. A shared color may occupy only one deleted matched pair; with three colors this forces n=3 and 6 colorings. For odd n≥5, four colors require exactly two shared matched pairs and one exclusive color on each remaining part, giving chi=4 and 24*binom(n,2)=12n(n-1) named optima. Independently brute-checked literal open-neighborhood parity and properness for n=3,4,5,6 and all palettes to optimum; all counts matched.
